descriptions.w3d_f12c_ensure_random_land_8026c54c: When the context property-name string is nonempty, look up its held interface, copy the current shared string with witnessed retain/release ownership, compare it to FE.Level.RandomLand and update the property when different, then release the interface and scoped string. Partial context, string and interface layouts and names are inferred; external property APIs and original strings remain separate obligations.
